messages.text: Morning all. Quick update on the Q3 stress scenario set: I've added the rates +200bp parallel shock and the credit spread widening scenario to RiskEngine over the weekend. Both are running in the overnight batch now.
Thanks Paul. Did you keep the equity -20% leg in the combined scenario, or are we running it standalone only?
Both. Standalone plus a combined severe case (equity -20%, rates +200bp, IG spreads +150bp). Combined is the one Martin asked for for the board pack.
Yes, I need headline numbers for the board pack by Thursday. Can someone give me the combined-scenario P&L hit and the capital impact once the batch finishes?
Batch finished at 8:40. Preliminary combined loss is about $41M against the firmwide book, which is roughly 9% of tier 1 capital. I'm still sanity-checking the position snapshot.
9% feels a bit high vs. last quarter's severe case. What changed? Is that the new spread shock or are we carrying more duration?
Mostly duration. The desk added a chunk of 7-10y corporates in July, so the rates leg bites harder. Spread shock adds maybe $9M on top of that.

On the credit side, I'm rerunning the loan book migration under the stress case. Assuming a two-notch downgrade across the CRE and leveraged portfolios. Will post expected loss deltas by early afternoon.
Phillip, I can take the leveraged loans piece if you handle CRE. We should use the same default-rate assumptions as the June run so the comparison is clean.
Works for me. I'll pull the CRE LTV refresh tonight's data and post the numbers in this thread.
Update: found a stale position for one swap book in the snapshot. After refreshing PositionStore, the combined loss drops to about $38.5M, so closer to 8.4% of tier 1.
Good catch, Angelica. That's more in line with what I expected. Please note the snapshot timestamp in the methodology footnote.
Thanks. Will the credit losses from Phillip and John be layered into that $38.5M, or reported separately in the pack?
Separately for now. Market and credit stress are different engines, so I'd show market P&L, credit EL, and then a simple combined total with a note on no diversification benefit.
Agree. Martin, we'll give you one summary table. Angelica will also refresh the ReportingBI stress dashboard so you can drill down.
On it. ReportingBI refresh is scheduled for 1pm, I'll ping here when the new scenario tabs are live.
Great, appreciate the quick turnaround everyone. I'll review the dashboard this afternoon and come back with questions before Thursday.
